record.title: Execute typed read-only query plans over an explicitly supplied stream
record.intent: Separate bounded byte transport from endpoint configuration and instrument authorization.
requirements: Accept only typed identity/status query plans over a caller-supplied exclusively owned stream; perform no connection discovery DNS scanning or connection creation.
Bound total transaction time and response bytes, preserve partial submission and response evidence, and never retry a query silently.
Distinguish local submission from peer delivery and interpretation; return named complete and incomplete outcomes with completed prefix retained.
Test fragmented I/O short writes EOF timeout malformed responses and partial failures using in-memory streams and owned Unix socket pairs only; no physical or external network traffic.
acceptance: Deterministic controls and installed library calls establish explicit transport outcomes without contacting a device.
